name: team-expert

frames.best_why: The heading, four expert cards with one hovered orange, and all four activity cards are visible.

tagline: Four expert portrait cards that turn burnt orange on hover.
summary: A light team showcase: a four-across row of portrait cards with names and roles that fill with orange on hover, and four activity cards beneath.
appearance: A warm off-white section under a centred heading and grey paragraph. Four portrait cards in pale peach hold a square photo, a bold name, a small role line and a READ MORE link; below sit four white cards with round orange icon tiles.
behaviour: Hovering a portrait card floods it solid orange, turns its text white and nudges the READ MORE arrow sideways. The activity icons swell slightly on hover too.
demo_content: Experts Eskild Ebbesen, Henrik Duer, Rikke Hørlykke and Stig Severinsen, with activities Workout and Mindfulness.
search_phrases: team section with four portrait cards
cards that turn orange on hover
expert profiles with read more links
people cards with photos and roles
team page with activity buttons below
use_when: A team or expert lineup needs small profile cards plus a row of related activities.
avoid_when: Four people are hardcoded, and hover-only colour changes are lost on touch.
customise: Names, roles, photos and activity titles come from the EXPERT_TEAM array and inline props; hover colours are classes.
weight_why: Eight static cards and CSS hover transitions, with a short reveal on scroll.

a11y.note: READ MORE buttons have no focus styling and no click handler, and hover is the only card feedback.

issues: READ MORE buttons have no click handler, so they do nothing.
Photos and names are hardcoded, and colour feedback appears on hover only.
polish_why: Warm card rhythm and a bold hover fill; the dead READ MORE buttons are the flaw.
